authority_source.verbatim: 继续 执行 ，一直执行。我全权授权给你替我审核，直到完成这一些列任务
authority_source.account_ownership_context: 用户已明确 Clued 现有账号全部为其自有测试账号，没有其他用户。
authority_source.evidence_boundary: Transcription of the instruction received by the executing agent, not a service-issued receipt, cryptographic signature, or platform role assignment.

delegator: current Clued project owner in the authenticated user conversation
delegatee: Codex acting for the user in this task

scope.steps: 1 through 21, in the fixed order, through Developer Skill and User Skill
capabilities: execute the scoped work and its necessary checks
review evidence and resolve findings on behalf of the user
record scoped acceptance and freeze decisions when their required evidence and preceding gates are satisfied
perform the authorized migration, consumer integration and enforcement after their respective prerequisites
commit, push and retain scoped implementation and evidence in the user's private project repository
delegate bounded execution and independent review to available agents

start_condition: This explicit user instruction has been received; each action additionally meets the applicable preceding step gate.
end_condition: The stated 21-step series is completed, or the user revokes or changes the delegation.
revocation: Any later user instruction revoking or narrowing this authority takes precedence for subsequent actions; retain prior evidence and history.
approval_requirement: No repeat user confirmation for actions and decisions already within this delegated task. Effective host permissions, available authenticated service scopes and any actual external authorization requirements still apply.
independence: Delegated approval does not replace the independent derivation required at Step 9. Author, evidence producer, independent reviewer and accepting delegate are identified separately in the corresponding records.
prohibited_inference: This delegation does not itself mean any step has passed, the architecture is accepted, the structure is frozen, or the project is released.
It does not supply unavailable metadata, convert UNKNOWN into PASS, or permit skipping or silently narrowing the fixed baseline.
It does not assign new platform credentials or bypass denied access.
It does not authorize unrelated work or alteration of preserved historical evidence.
